ideas.pitch: An AI-powered digital property valuation engine that combines satellite imagery analysis with local real estate transaction records for instant, explainable collateral valuation.
ideas.title: GeoProp AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages geospatial intelligence patterns similar to GeoNex-ATLAS, providing a tangible computer-vision and map-based dashboard that financial institution judges can instantly test with live coordinates.

ideas.pitch: A fully automated mortgage underwriting platform featuring deterministic risk gates, automated document verification, and instant compliance checks for Home Loans and Loans Against Property.
ideas.title: UnderwriteFlow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the multi-agent risk gate architectures seen in Should-AI-Buy, offering judges strict compliance guardrails and transparent automated credit decisioning logs rather than a black-box model.

ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence platform connecting property attributes, historical transaction data, and micro-market trends to detect valuation anomalies and real estate fraud for Hero Housing Finance.
ideas.title: ValuGraph India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies graph intelligence and explainable machine learning techniques directly to real estate valuation, matching the technical depth of the Bito winning solution.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent document processing and fraud detection engine built specifically for parsing property deeds, bank statements, and KYC forms in Indian mortgage workflows.
ideas.title: DocuVerify AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the tedious document verification bottleneck in housing finance with a working live demo that extracts unstructured text into validated structured schemas.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end risk scoring and loan-against-property underwriting sandbox featuring adversarial stress-testing of borrower cash flows and collateral liquidation values.
ideas.title: RiskGate LAP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Incorporates adversarial thesis falsification and rigorous risk gates, giving financial underwriters confidence in the system's ability to handle edge-case defaults.
